name: Almond Honey Protein Bar (Rise Bar)

justification: Honey + almond matrix satisfies Principle 4 (no rapid-influx refined sugar) and Principle 3 (no oxidized seed oils), but the artificially isolated whey (Principle 2, denatured/engineered isolate) keeps it at the clean-tool Tier 2 rather than the native whole-food gold standard.
notes: Only 3 ingredients; cleanest engineered-protein bar in the set.
